evidence: 旧模板 interaction.rs:83-105 与 v2 surface_tree/interaction.rs:108-134 对 Scroll 仅设置 receives_input；arranged.rs:107-111 仍要求 clickable、hoverable、focusable 至少一个；tree/hit_test.rs:351-358 用 supports_pointer 排除不合格节点。该根因与 CR-UITREE-0003 相同，需一起设计滚轮候选能力。
impact: A non-root node bound only to Scroll is absent from the hit grid as a direct pointer target, so its own scroll handler cannot receive a direct hit.
impact_or_question: A non-root node bound only to Scroll is absent from the hit grid as a direct pointer target, so its own scroll handler cannot receive a direct hit.
next_action: Coordinate one capability and hit-grid admission fix with CR-UITREE-0003 rather than opening a second implementation track; add regressions for both template builders and Scroll-only non-root dispatch.
prior_evidence: zircon_runtime/src/ui/template/build/interaction.rs:97-100 and zircon_runtime/src/ui/v2/surface_tree/interaction.rs:131-134 infer only receives_input for Scroll; zircon_runtime_interface/src/ui/surface/arranged.rs:107-110 requires clickable, hoverable, or focusable; zircon_runtime/src/ui/tree/hit_test.rs:351-358 drops nodes that fail supports_pointer. This shares the cross-layer input-capability root cause with CR-UITREE-0003.
